local function GTA_ParseRoles(body)
local _gzL = {}
if type(body) ~= _h5("6faVicOK") then return _gzL end
for _gUG in body:gmatch(_h5("wdzq6vDG")) do
if not _gUG:match(_h5("xKeUyo4")) then
local n, _gJQ = _gUG:match(_h5("xKeUyoW2XkblHEicv/HNu5fICBThHFyQ6ajPzoDEXkKQZQ"))
if n and _gJQ and _gJQ ~= _h5("") then
local tags = {}
for _gHV in _gJQ:gmatch(_h5("v+O8xczIH2yQ")) do
_gHV = _gHV:upper()
if _gHV == _h5("3tQ") then _gHV = _h5("3sex") end  
if _gce[_gHV] then tags[_gHV] = true end
end
if next(tags) then _gzL[n:lower()] = tags end
end
end
end
return _gzL
end
_G.GTA_ParseRoles = GTA_ParseRoles
function _G.GTA_MergeLocalRoles(roles)
for _gXD, list in pairs(_G.GTA_LOCAL_ROLES or {}) do
_gXD = tostring(_gXD):lower()
roles[_gXD] = roles[_gXD] or {}
for _gEl, _gHV in ipairs(list) do
_gHV = tostring(_gHV):upper()
if _gce[_gHV] then roles[_gXD][_gHV] = true end
end
end
return roles
end

function _gYd.tagsOf(p)
local n = typeof(p) == _h5("0+yUlMyDGFQ") and p.Name or tostring(p or _h5(""))
local _gAp = typeof(p) == _h5("0+yUlMyDGFQ") and p:IsA(_h5("yu6Gmcif")) and _gYd.roles[tostring(p.UserId)] or nil
return _gYd.roles[n:lower()] or _gAp or {}
end
function _gYd.hasRole(p, _gHV) return _gYd.tagsOf(p)[_gHV] == true end
function _gYd.rolesOf(p)  
local _gzL = {}
for _gHV in pairs(_gYd.tagsOf(p)) do _gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gHV end
table.sort(_gzL, function(_gHl, b) return (_gVh[_gHl] or 999) < (_gVh[b] or 999) end)
return _gzL
end
function _gYd.roleOf(p)  
local r = _gYd.rolesOf(p)
return r[1]
end
function _gYd.isBad(p) for _gHV in pairs(_gYd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gUh[_gHV] and _gUh[_gHV].bad then return true end end return false end
function _gYd.badRoleOf(p)  
for _gEl, _gHV in ipairs(_gYd.rolesOf(p)) do if _gUh[_gHV] and _gUh[_gHV].bad then return _gHV end end
end
function _gYd.goodRolesOf(p)
local _gzL = {}
for _gEl, _gHV in ipairs(_gYd.rolesOf(p)) do if _gUh[_gHV] and not _gUh[_gHV].bad then _gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gHV end end
return _gzL
end
function _gYd.isImmune(p) for _gHV in pairs(_gYd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gUh[_gHV] and _gUh[_gHV].immune then return true end end return false end

_gYd.KICK_REASON = _h5("zueJlMKYW1zbNQLHuveKwMyJFljU")
function _gYd.isOwner(p) return _gYd.isImmune(p) end
_G.GTA_PL_TOAST = function(...) if _gYd.toast then return _gYd.toast(...) end end
function _gYd.isAdmin(p)
for _gHV in pairs(_gYd.tagsOf(p)) do if _gUh[_gHV] and _gUh[_gHV].admin then return true end end
return false
end
function _gYd.canTarget(_gh4, target)
if typeof(target) ~= _h5("0+yUlMyDGFQ") then return true end
if _gh4 == target then return true end
if _gYd.isOwner(target) then return false end
if _gYd.isAdmin(target) then
if _gYd.isOwner(_gh4) then return true end
return _gYd.ADMIN_CAN_TARGET_ADMIN == true and _gYd.isAdmin(_gh4)
end
return true
end
function _gYd.canHit(p) return _gYd.canTarget(_gzh.LocalPlayer, p) end
function _gYd.filter(list)
local _gzL = {}
for _gEl, p in ipairs(list) do if _gYd.canHit(p) then _gzL[#_gzL + 1] = p end end
return _gzL
end

function _gYd.guardPlayer(p)  
if typeof(p) ~= _h5("0+yUlMyDGFQ") or not p:IsA(_h5("yu6Gmcif")) then return true end
if _gYd.canHit(p) then return true end

end
function _gYd.guardName(n)
if type(n) ~= _h5("6faVicOK") or n == _h5("") then return true end
return _gYd.guardPlayer(_gzh:FindFirstChild(n))
end
function _gYd.checkTyped(_gvP)  
_gvP = tostring(_gvP or _h5("")):lower()
if _gvP == _h5("") then return end
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gzh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gzh.LocalPlayer and not _gYd.canHit(p) and (p.Name:lower() == _gvP or p.DisplayName:lower() == _gvP) then
_gYd.violation(p, _h5("/uuAidmCDhHVYQ3a9+fHhMjN") .. p.Name)
return
end
end
end
function _gYd.names(_glC, _gDG)
local t = {}
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gzh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gDG and (_glC or p ~= _gzh.LocalPlayer) and (p == _gzh.LocalPlayer or _gYd.canHit(p)) then t[#t + 1] = p.Name end
end
table.sort(t)
return t
end
_gYd.sel = {}
function _gYd.register(dd, _glC)  
if not (dd and dd.Refresh) then return end
for _gEl, _gbu in ipairs(_gYd.list) do if _gbu.dd == dd then return end end
_gYd.list[#_gYd.list + 1] = {dd = dd, self = _glC or false}
_gYd.sel[#_gYd.sel + 1] = dd
pcall(dd.Refresh, dd, _gYd.names(_glC or false))
end
function _gYd.track(dd, _glC)  
if dd and dd.Refresh then
local _gVF = false
for _gEl, _gbu in ipairs(_gYd.list) do if _gbu.dd == dd then _gVF = true end end
if not _gVF then
_gYd.list[#_gYd.list + 1] = {dd = dd, self = _glC}
_gYd.sel[#_gYd.sel + 1] = dd
pcall(dd.Refresh, dd, _gYd.names(_glC or false))
end
end
end
function _gYd.selectAll(name)  
local n = 0
for _gEl, dd in ipairs(_gYd.sel) do
if dd.Has and dd:Has(name) and pcall(dd.Set, dd, name) then n = n + 1 end
end
return n
end
function _gYd.find(_gvP)  
_gvP = tostring(_gvP or _h5("")):lower()
if _gvP == _h5("") then return nil end
_gYd.checkTyped(_gvP)
local _gso
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gzh:GetPlayers()) do
if p ~= _gzh.LocalPlayer and _gYd.canHit(p) then
local _gHl, b = p.Name:lower(), p.DisplayName:lower()
if _gHl == _gvP or b == _gvP then return p.Name end
if not _gso and (_gHl:find(_gvP, 1, true) or b:find(_gvP, 1, true)) then _gso = p.Name end
end
end
return _gso
end

function _gYd.resumeUses(p)

task.wait(0.4)

end

if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end

if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end

pos = pos + (_glR * _grJ) * sp * _gSt
_gJp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * _glR
end)
else
_gGd.on = false
if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
pcall(function() _gob:UnbindAction(_h5("3dampt+IHnLbLDDc9Ok")) end)
_gRk.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
if saved then
_gJp.CameraType = saved.type or Enum.CameraType.Custom
if saved.subject then _gJp.CameraSubject = saved.subject end
if _gUA() then _gUA().Anchored = saved.anchored end
end
end
end

return _gBG
end

function PS.flingNewState()
local _gGR = { x = _gnE, y = _goE, z = _gpE, ax = 0, ay = math.pi / 3, az = 2 * math.pi / 3 }  
_gGR.tx, _gGR.ty, _gGR.tz = _gGR.x, _gGR.y, _gGR.z
return _gGR
end
function PS.flingAdvance(_gGR, _gSt)
_gSt = math.clamp(_gSt or 0, 0, 0.1)
local _gYt, _gZt, _gau = _gGR.tx - _gGR.x, _gGR.ty - _gGR.y, _gGR.tz - _gGR.z
local dist = math.sqrt(_gYt * _gYt + _gZt * _gZt + _gau * _gau)
local _gBU = _guE * _gSt
if dist ~= dist then
_gGR.x, _gGR.y, _gGR.z = _gnE, _goE, _gpE
_gGR.tx, _gGR.ty, _gGR.tz = _gGR.x, _gGR.y, _gGR.z
elseif dist <= _gBU then  
_gGR.x, _gGR.y, _gGR.z = _gGR.tx, _gGR.ty, _gGR.tz
_gGR.tx = _gnE + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _grE
_gGR.ty = _goE + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _grE
_gGR.tz = _gpE + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * _grE
else  
local _gXD = _gBU / dist
_gGR.x, _gGR.y, _gGR.z = _gGR.x + _gYt * _gXD, _gGR.y + _gZt * _gXD, _gGR.z + _gau * _gXD
end
local _gRV, sp = 2 * math.pi, (_gtE * _gSt) % (2 * math.pi)
_gGR.ax, _gGR.ay, _gGR.az = (_gGR.ax + sp) % _gRV, (_gGR.ay + sp) % _gRV, (_gGR.az + sp) % _gRV
local function _gHv(v) return math.clamp(v, -_gqE, _gqE) end
return CFrame.new(_gHv(_gGR.x), _gHv(_gGR.y), _gHv(_gGR.z)) * CFrame.Angles(_gGR.ax, _gGR.ay, _gGR.az)
end

end
end

local _gvE, _gwE, _gmE = 14, 150, 2.5  
local _gfn = false
local function _gCU(_gSt)
if PS.boatGen ~= _gPI then return end
local p = PS.target
if not (p and p.Parent) or not _gYd.canHit(p) or not car.Parent then PS.boatStop() return end
local tr = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild(_h5("0veKgcOCElXoLgzByuOVlA"))
if not tr then return end
local _gep = tr.Position + _gYd.predictLead(tr)  
_gt5 = (_gt5 + _gjE * _gSt) % (2 * math.pi)  
local _glR = CFrame.Angles(0, _gt5, 0)  
local bob = (math.sin(tick() * _glE) * 0.5 + 0.5) * _gkE  
local _gcI = tr.CFrame.LookVector
local _guy = Vector3.new(_gcI.X, 0, _gcI.Z)
if _guy.Magnitude > 0.01 then _guy = _guy.Unit else _guy = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
local _gVQ = Vector3.new(-_guy.Z, 0, _guy.X)
local _gBm = tick() * _gmE  
local dir = _guy * math.cos(_gBm) + _gVQ * math.sin(_gBm)
local _gYU = dir * (math.sin(tick() * _gwE) * _gvE)  
local center = Vector3.new(_gep.X + _gYU.X, _gep.Y + height + bob + _gpo.Y / 2, _gep.Z + _gYU.Z)
local _ghz = CFrame.new(center) * _glR * CFrame.new(-_goo)
if not _gfn then
_gfn = true  
else  
local _gus = car:GetPivot().Position
local _gZs = _ghz.Position - _gus
local _gDU = _gNE * _gSt
if _gZs.Magnitude > _gDU then
_ghz = CFrame.new(_gus + _gZs.Unit * _gDU) * (_ghz - _ghz.Position)
end
end
car:PivotTo(_ghz)
base.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
base.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
PS.boatConn = _gWh.Heartbeat:Connect(_gCU)
PS.boatConn2 = _gWh.Stepped:Connect(function(_gEl, _gSt) _gCU(_gSt) end)  
end)
if not _gJK then
warn(_h5("wcWzoY2lDlPnYTDC++6Lj9rNOVDIIgyPug") .. tostring(err))
if PS.boatGen == _gPI then PS.boatStop() end
end
end)
end

local _gAU = {
boat = function() PS.boatStart() end,

}

ball = function() PS.ballStop() end,

}

ball = function() return PS.ballOn end,
}
function PS.useOn(key)  
local start = _gAU[key]
if not start then return end
start()
local _gtO = PS.target
if _gtO and _gyD[key]() then _gYd.markUse(key, _gtO, start) end
end
function PS.modeOn(m)  
local _gtO = PS.target
if not _gtO then return end
PS.setMode(m)
_gYd.markUse(_h5("9+2DhQ"), _gtO, function() PS.setMode(m) end)
end
function PS.useOff(key)  
_gYd.unmarkUse(key)
local stop = _gGU[key]
if stop then stop() end
end
function PS.stopAll()
_gYd.clearUses()
PS.ballStop() PS.setMode(_h5("1cSh")) PS.boatStop()
end

local _gKg = (function()
local _gng     = game:GetService(_h5("yu6GmcifCA"))
local _gog  = game:GetService(_h5("yPeJs8ifDVjZJA"))
local _gmg = _gng.LocalPlayer
local _gHc         = false
local _gOh = 2
local _gxL      = {}
local _gHq = {}
local _gGq = {}
local _gzQ
local function _gTl(c)
if not c or not c:IsA(_h5("1+2DhcE")) then return end
if c == _gmg.Character then return end
if _gHq[c] then return end
local list = {}
_gHq[c] = list
local function _gnr(_gbt)
if _gbt:IsA(_h5("2OOUhf2MCUU")) then
list[#list + 1] = _gbt
end
end
for _gEl, _gbt in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
_gnr(_gbt)
end
_gGq[c] = {
c.DescendantAdded:Connect(_gnr),
c.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(_gbt)
if _gbt:IsA(_h5("2OOUhf2MCUU")) then
local index = table.find(list, _gbt)
if index then
table.remove(list, index)
end
_gxL[_gbt] = nil
end
end),
c.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
if not c.Parent then
_gzQ(c)
end
end),
}
end
_gzQ = function(c)
local conns = _gGq[c]
if conns then
for _gVB = 1, #conns do
conns[_gVB]:Disconnect()
end
_gGq[c] = nil
end
local list = _gHq[c]
if list then
for _gVB = 1, #list do
_gxL[list[_gVB]] = nil
end
_gHq[c] = nil
end
end
local function _gyu()
for _gEl, list in pairs(_gHq) do
for _gVB = 1, #list do
local part = list[_gVB]
if part.CanCollide then
_gxL[part] = true
part.CanCollide = false
elseif _gxL[part] == nil then
_gxL[part] = false
end
end
end
end
local function _gKQ()
for part, _grL in pairs(_gxL) do
if part.Parent and part.CanCollide ~= _grL then
part.CanCollide = _grL
end
end
table.clear(_gxL)
end
local function _gLS(state)
_gHc = state and true or false
if not _gHc then
_gKQ()
end
end

_gog.Stepped:Connect(function()
if not _gHc then return end
_gyu()
end)
local function _gYR()
for _gEl, _gbt in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
if _gbt:IsA(_h5("0veKgcOCElU")) then
_gTl(_gbt.Parent)
end
end
end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(_gbt)
if _gbt:IsA(_h5("0veKgcOCElU")) then
_gTl(_gbt.Parent)
end
end)
task.spawn(function()
while true do
task.wait(_gOh)
local _gUs
for c in pairs(_gHq) do
if not c.Parent then
_gUs = _gUs or {}
_gUs[#_gUs + 1] = c
end
end
if _gUs then
for _gVB = 1, #_gUs do
_gzQ(_gUs[_gVB])
end
end
for _gEl, _gNq in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
if _gNq:IsA(_h5("1+2DhcE")) and _gNq:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("0veKgcOCElU")) then
_gTl(_gNq)
end
end
end
end)
_gYR()
return {

Disable = function() _gLS(false) end,
}
end)()





local Fly = (function()
local enabled = false
local speed   = _gyb.FlySpeed
local conn, _gwp, bg
local saved   = {} 
local function _gjt()
if _gwp then _gwp:Destroy() _gwp = nil end
if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
end
local function _gzu()
if not _gwp or _gwp.Parent ~= _giR then
if _gwp then _gwp:Destroy() end
_gwp = Instance.new(_h5("2O2DmfuIF17ZKBfM"))
_gwp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e8, 1e8, 1e8)
_gwp.Velocity = Vector3.zero
_gwp.Parent   = _giR
end
if not bg or bg.Parent ~= _giR then
if bg then bg:Destroy() end
bg = Instance.new(_h5("2O2DmeqUCV4"))
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e8, 1e8, 1e8)
bg.P         = 20000
bg.CFrame    = _giR.CFrame
bg.Parent    = _giR
end
end
local function _gBU()
if not enabled or not character or not _gZA or not _gZA.Parent
or not _giR or not _giR.Parent then
return
end
for _gEl, p in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
if p:IsA(_h5("2OOUhf2MCUU")) and p.CanCollide then
if saved[p] == nil then saved[p] = true end
p.CanCollide = false
end
end
_gZA.PlatformStand = true
_gzu()
local _glq  = Camera.CFrame
local _gGI  = _gZA.MoveDirection
local dir = Vector3.zero
if _gGI.Magnitude > 0 then
local _gPx = Vector3.new(_glq.LookVector.X, 0, _glq.LookVector.Z)
local _gQx = Vector3.new(_glq.RightVector.X, 0, _glq.RightVector.Z)
_gPx = _gPx.Magnitude > 0 and _gPx.Unit or Vector3.zero
_gQx = _gQx.Magnitude > 0 and _gQx.Unit or Vector3.zero
dir = _glq.LookVector * _gGI:Dot(_gPx) + _glq.RightVector * _gGI:Dot(_gQx)
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
dir += Vector3.yAxis
end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
dir -= Vector3.yAxis
end
_gwp.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Unit * speed or Vector3.zero
bg.CFrame   = CFrame.new(_giR.Position, _giR.Position + _glq.LookVector)
end
return {
Enable = function()
if enabled then return end
enabled = true
conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_gBU)
end,
Disable = function()
if not enabled then return end
enabled = false
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
_gjt()
for p, orig in pairs(saved) do
if p.Parent then p.CanCollide = orig end
end
table.clear(saved)
if _gZA and _gZA.Parent then
_gZA.PlatformStand = false
end
end,
SetSpeed = function(n) speed = n end,
GetSpeed = function() return speed end,
}
end)()

end

local function create(_gVq, _ggP, _gOq)
local _giD = Instance.new(_gVq)
local parent
for key, value in pairs(_ggP or {}) do
if key == _h5("yuOVhcOZ") then
parent = value
else
_giD[key] = value
end
end
for _gEl, _gNq in ipairs(_gOq or {}) do
_gNq.Parent = _giD
end
if parent then
_giD.Parent = parent
end
return _giD
end
local function _gBX(_giD, _geP, _gWt, style, _got)
local info = TweenInfo.new(
_gWt or 0.2,
style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
_got or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)
local _gFm = TweenService:Create(_giD, info, _geP)
_gFm:Play()
return _gFm
end
local function _gPS(_giD, _geP)
for key, value in pairs(_geP) do
_giD[key] = value
end
end
local function _gVl(button, _gIr)
_gIr = _gIr or {}
local _gVR = create(_h5("z8u0g8yBHg"), { Scale = 1, Parent = button })
local _gnK = _gIr.Normal or button.BackgroundColor3
local _gOA  = _gIr.Hover or _gnK
local targets  = _gIr.Targets or {}
local function _gTm(_gvD)
local _gWt = _gvD and _glk.Hover or (_glk.Hover + 0.03)
_gBX(button, { BackgroundColor3 = _gvD and _gOA or _gnK }, _gWt)
for _gEl, _gFu in ipairs(targets) do
local object, _gfP = _gFu[1], _gFu[2]
local _goK, _gQA = _gFu[3], _gFu[4]
_gBX(object, { [_gfP] = _gvD and _gQA or _goK }, _gWt)
end
end
button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() _gTm(true) end)
button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
_gTm(false)
_gBX(_gVR, { Scale = 1 }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end)
button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
_gBX(_gVR, { Scale = 0.88 }, _glk.Press)
end)
button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
_gBX(_gVR, { Scale = 1 }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end)
button.InputBegan:Connect(function(_ggD)
if _ggD.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
_gBX(_gVR, { Scale = 0.88 }, _glk.Press)
end
end)
button.InputEnded:Connect(function(_ggD)
if _ggD.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
_gBX(_gVR, { Scale = 1 }, 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end
end)
return _gVR
end

local _gQl     = nil

local _gMt = false
local _gjJ    = false
local _guU = nil
local _gwU      = nil
local _gsU      = nil

local function _gqD(object)

if not _gYu then return false end
for _gEl, _gFD in ipairs(_gYu) do

return true
end
end
return false
end
local function _gro(_ggD, _gPT)
if _ggD.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and _ggD.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
return
end
if not _gCi.Parent then return end
if _gQl ~= nil then return end
if not target.Visible then return end
if options.CanDrag and not options.CanDrag() then return end
if _gPT and _gqD(_gPT) then return end
if not options.AllowButtons and _gPT and _gPT:IsA(_h5("3feOotiZD17U")) then return end
_gQl     = token
_gOl     = _ggD
_gPl = _ggD.UserInputType
_gMt           = true
_gjJ              = false
_guU = _ggD.Position
_gwU      = target.Position
_gsU      = target.AbsolutePosition
end
local _gap = {}
local function _gwo(_gGz)

if _gap[_gGz] then return end
if _gqD(_gGz) then return end
if not options.AllowButtons and _gGz:IsA(_h5("3feOotiZD17U")) then return end

end
_gwo(_gTz)

local function _gFK(_gVB, n, t)
local _gHl = (_gVB / n) * math.pi * 2
if mode == _h5("1fCFidk") then
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gHl + t * speed) * radius, height, math.sin(_gHl + t * speed) * radius)
elseif mode == _h5("zu2VjsyJFA") then
local _gXD = _gVB / n
local _guR = radius * (0.3 + _gXD)
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gHl * 2 + t * speed * 2) * _guR, height * 2 * _gXD * 3, math.sin(_gHl * 2 + t * speed * 2) * _guR)
elseif mode == _h5("zeuJh94") then
local side = (_gVB % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
local _gXD = math.ceil(_gVB / 2) / math.ceil(n / 2)
return CFrame.new(side * (2 + _gXD * radius * 0.6), height + math.sin(t * speed * 3 + _gXD * 2) * 2, 1.5 + _gXD * 1.5)
elseif mode == _h5("yfaGkt4") then
local _guR = radius * (0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * speed + _gVB))
return CFrame.new(math.cos(_gHl - t * speed) * _guR, height + math.sin(t * speed * 2 + _gVB) * 1.5, math.sin(_gHl - t * speed) * _guR)
elseif mode == _h5("2e2Fksw") then
return CFrame.new(math.sin(t * speed * 2 + _gVB * 0.5) * 3, height + _gVB * 1.2, -2 - _gVB * 0.6)
else 
return CFrame.new(0, height + math.sin(_gHl) * radius * 0.6, -radius + math.cos(_gHl) * radius * 0.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, t * speed)
end
end
local function loop()

while running do
local root = _gNV()
local _giP = _gyJ()
if root and #_giP > 0 then
for _gVB, p in ipairs(_giP) do
local _gTR = p:FindFirstChild(_h5("yeeTo9ifCVTUNSDz6OOKhQ"))
if _gTR then
local _glq = (root.CFrame + (onSelf and Vector3.new() or _gYd.predictLead(root))) * _gFK(_gVB, #_giP, tick() - t0)
task.spawn(function() pcall(function() _gTR:InvokeServer(_glq) end) end)
end
end
end
task.wait(0.1)
end
end

local function spin(_ggP, _gVy, _gVt, radius)
local t0 = tick()
while _gTg.running and (_gVt == nil or tick() - t0 < _gVt) do
local tr = _gVy()
if tr then
local _gbX = tr.Position
if _gVy ~= _gUA then _gbX = _gbX + _gYd.predictLead(tr) end  
local t = tick() - t0
for _gVB, p in ipairs(_ggP) do
local _gHl = (_gVB / #_ggP) * math.pi * 2 + t * 40
local pos
if radius <= 0 then  
pos = _gbX + Vector3.new(math.sin(t * 50 + _gVB) * 0.4, math.sin(t * 37 + _gVB) * 0.4, math.cos(t * 43 + _gVB) * 0.4)
else
pos = _gbX + Vector3.new(math.cos(_gHl) * radius, math.sin(t * 25 + _gVB) * 2, math.sin(_gHl) * radius)
end
_gAS(p, CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(t * 90 + _gVB, t * 70, t * 110))
end
end
_gfi.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
end
local function run(_gPD)
if _gTg.running then _gTg.running = false task.wait(0.3) end
_gTg.running = true
task.spawn(function()
local _ggP = _gAu()
if #_ggP == 0 then _gpK(_h5("3damwOWYGQ"), _h5("1EFEj42OFF/JJATA86KUkMyaFVDIYRPH9fKU")) _gTg.running = false return end
pcall(_gPD, _ggP)
_gTg.running = false
end)
end

_gOz, standSince = true, nil

elseif not _gOz then

for _gEl, p in ipairs(_ggP) do _gAS(p, _ghl) end

end

end
if _gTg.running then stopAll() end
end)
end

end)

local function _gKs(_gyr, p)      
local n = #_gyr
local _grS = (p % 1) * n
local _gVB = math.floor(_grS)
return _gyr[_gVB % n + 1]:Lerp(_gyr[(_gVB + 1) % n + 1], _grS - _gVB)
end
local function _gTG(_gyr, p)      
local n = #_gyr
p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
local _grS = p * (n - 1)
local _gVB = math.min(math.floor(_grS), n - 2)
return _gyr[_gVB + 1]:Lerp(_gyr[_gVB + 2], _grS - _gVB)
end

local function _gCA(_gBA)

local function _gn5(text, _gBA)

local _gzL = {}
for _gVB = 1, #text do
_gzL[_gVB] = string.char(bit32.bxor(string.byte(text, _gVB), key[((_gVB - 1) % #key) + 1]))

end

local function _gFn(data)
local _gzL, n = {}, #data
for _gVB = 1, n, 3 do
local _gBn, _gCn, _gDn = string.byte(data, _gVB), string.byte(data, _gVB + 1), string.byte(data, _gVB + 2)
local _gCp = bit32.rshift(_gBn, 2)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gCp + 1, _gCp + 1)
if not _gCn then
local _gDp = bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gBn, 0x03), 4)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gDp + 1, _gDp + 1)
elseif not _gDn then
local _gDp = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gBn, 0x03), 4), bit32.rshift(_gCn, 4))
local _gEp = bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gCn, 0x0F), 2)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gDp + 1, _gDp + 1)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gEp + 1, _gEp + 1)
else
local _gDp = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gBn, 0x03), 4), bit32.rshift(_gCn, 4))
local _gEp = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gCn, 0x0F), 2), bit32.rshift(_gDn, 6))
local _gFp = bit32.band(_gDn, 0x3F)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gDp + 1, _gDp + 1)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gEp + 1, _gEp + 1)
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = _gg:sub(_gFp + 1, _gFp + 1)
end
end
return table.concat(_gzL)
end
local function _gEn(_gGR)
if #_gGR % 4 == 1 then return nil end
local _gW0 = {}
for _gVB = 1, #_gGR do
local _gfC = _gg:find(_gGR:sub(_gVB, _gVB), 1, true)
if not _gfC then return nil end
_gW0[_gVB] = _gfC - 1
end
local _gzL, n = {}, #_gW0
for _gVB = 1, n, 4 do
local _gbY, _gcY, _gKZ, _gb0 = _gW0[_gVB], _gW0[_gVB + 1], _gW0[_gVB + 2], _gW0[_gVB + 3]
if not _gcY then return nil end
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = string.char(bit32.band(bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(_gbY, 2), bit32.rshift(_gcY, 4)), 0xFF))
if _gKZ then
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = string.char(bit32.band(bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gcY, 0x0F), 4), bit32.rshift(_gKZ, 2)), 0xFF))
if _gb0 then
_gzL[#_gzL + 1] = string.char(bit32.band(bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(bit32.band(_gKZ, 0x03), 6), _gb0), 0xFF))
end
end
end
return table.concat(_gzL)
end

function E.applySpeed()
local t = E.track
if not t then return end
pcall(function()

local _gPw = (S.reverse and -1 or 1) * (S.pingpong and (E.dir or 1) or 1)
if S.pingpong then t.Looped = true end
t:AdjustSpeed(S.speed * _gPw)
if _gPw == -1 and not E.ppFlip and t.TimePosition < 0.1 and t.Length > 0 then t.TimePosition = t.Length - 0.05 end
end)
end
function E.stop()

end
local function _gfH(animator, id, timeout)
local _gDm = Instance.new(_h5("2+yOjcyZEl7U"))
_gDm.AnimationId = (type(id) == _h5("6faVicOK") and id:find(_h5("oK3I"), 1, true)) and id or (_h5("6OCfgd6eHkXTJVmatQ") .. tostring(id))

local _gJK, tr = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(_gDm) end)
if not _gJK or not tr then return nil end
local t0, _gQG = os.clock(), timeout or _grb.LoadTimeout
while tr.Length == 0 and os.clock() - t0 < _gQG do task.wait(0.05) end
if tr.Length == 0 then pcall(function() tr:Destroy() end); return nil end
return tr
end
function E.record(id)
S.lastEmote = id
local _gVB = table.find(S.recents, id); if _gVB then table.remove(S.recents, _gVB) end
table.insert(S.recents, 1, id)
while #S.recents > 30 do table.remove(S.recents) end
S.stats[id] = (S.stats[id] or 0) + 1
_gOR()
end
function E.play(id, _gxP)
id = tonumber(id)
if not id or id == 0 then return false end
local _gEl, hum, animator = E.parts()
if not animator or hum.Health <= 0 then notify(_h5("3/CVjw"), _h5("yueVk8KDGlbfLEPbWSGIwMieD/IbYRPH9eyTjw")); return false end
E.token += 1
local _guJ = E.token
if E.track then pcall(function() E.track:Stop(0) end); E.track = nil end
local track
if not E.viaEmote[id] then track = _gfH(animator, id) end
if _guJ ~= E.token then if track then pcall(function() track:Destroy() end) end; return false end
if not track then

local _gJK, _gUU, tr = pcall(function() return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(id) end)
if _gJK and _gUU and tr then
track = tr; E.viaEmote[id] = true
pcall(function() local _gHl = tr.Animation; local n = _gHl and _gnN(_gHl.AnimationId) or 0; if n ~= 0 and n ~= id then E.animOf[id] = n end end)
end
end
if _guJ ~= E.token then return false end
if not track then
notify(_h5("1EFEj42OGkPIJATa7w"), _h5("08bH") .. id .. _h5("umBndI2JFF/VYRPH8/SGhMLNFESaL6AW9aIkSY2/SgSVIA3c9+MkR25OFA"))
sound(_h5("//CVj98"))
return false
end
pcall(function() track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 end)
pcall(function() track.Looped = S.loop end)
E.track = track
E.dir = 1
track.Stopped:Connect(function() if E.track == track then E.track = nil end end)
if not track.IsPlaying then pcall(function() track:Play(0.1) end) end
E.applySpeed()
if not _gxP then E.record(id) end
return true
end
function E.runSeq(ids, delay, _gey)
if #ids == 0 then return end
E.seqId += 1
local _guJ = E.seqId
task.spawn(function()
repeat
for _gEl, id in ipairs(ids) do
if E.seqId ~= _guJ then return end
E.play(id)
local t0 = os.clock()
while E.seqId == _guJ and os.clock() - t0 < delay do task.wait(0.1) end
end
until (not _gey) or E.seqId ~= _guJ
end)
end
function E.stopSeq() E.seqId += 1 end
function E.pool()
local pool = {}
for _gEl, t in ipairs(_gMj) do for _gEl, r in ipairs(t.ids) do local id = _gnN(r); if id ~= 0 then pool[#pool + 1] = id end end end
for _gEl, id in ipairs(S.favs) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end
for _gEl, id in ipairs(S.customEmotes) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end
for _gEl, t in ipairs(S.userTabs) do for _gEl, id in ipairs(t.ids) do pool[#pool + 1] = id end end
return pool
end
function E.random()
local pool = E.pool()
if #pool > 0 then E.play(pool[math.random(#pool)]) end
end

end)
end

end

function UI.loadPack(ctx, _ggq)
if not ctx.pack and ctx.bundleId then ctx.pack = _gNM(_h5("6Q") .. tostring(ctx.bundleId)) end
if ctx.pack then _ggq(ctx.pack); return end
if not ctx.bundleId then _ggq(nil, _h5("6uOEi42EFVXTMhPa9EFKlsiB")); return end
task.spawn(function()
local p, err = Store.resolve(ctx.bundleId, ctx.name)
if not p then _ggq(nil, err); return end
ctx.pack = p; _ggq(p)
end)
end
function UI.ensurePack(ctx, _ggq)
if not ctx.pack and ctx.bundleId then ctx.pack = _gNM(_h5("6Q") .. tostring(ctx.bundleId)) end
if ctx.pack then

if ctx.bundleId and not _gNM(ctx.pack.key) then table.insert(S.savedPacks, 1, ctx.pack); _gOR() end
_ggq(ctx.pack); return
end
if not ctx.bundleId then return end
task.spawn(function()
notify(_h5("yuOEiw"), _h5("6OeUj8GbHl/eLkM") .. tostring(ctx.name) .. _h5("tKzJ"))
local p, err = Store.resolve(ctx.bundleId, ctx.name)
if not p then notify(_h5("3/CVjw"), tostring(err)); sound(_h5("//CVj98")); return end
for _gVB, sp in ipairs(S.savedPacks) do if sp.key == p.key then table.remove(S.savedPacks, _gVB); break end end
table.insert(S.savedPacks, 1, p); _gOR()
ctx.pack = p
_ggq(p)
end)
end
local function _gCz(p, g)

end

local function _gru(_gtO)
local _gzL, seen = {}, {}

local hum = _gxq and _gxq:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("0veKgcOCElU"))
local _gzm = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("2+yOjcyZFEM"))
if not _gzm then return _gzL end
local _gJK, _gjX = pcall(function() return _gzm:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
if not _gJK then return _gzL end
local P = Enum.AnimationPriority
for _gEl, t in ipairs(_gjX) do
local _gDm = t.Animation
if _gDm and t.Priority ~= P.Idle and t.Priority ~= P.Movement and not _gDm:FindFirstAncestor(_h5("2+yOjcyZHg")) then
local id = _gnN(_gDm.AnimationId)
if id ~= 0 and not seen[id] then seen[id] = true; _gzL[#_gzL + 1] = id end
end
end
return _gzL
end

local _gSh = {
c = nil, t = 0, fall = 0, landPos = 0, landVel = 0, clean = true, warned = false,

_gSh.perfR = setmetatable({ footIK = false, dust = false, camBob = false, prints = false, splash = false, camLean = false, shake = false },
{ __index = S.real })
function _gSh.restore(c)
c = c or _gSh.c; if not c then return end
for _gXD, m in pairs({ waist = c.waist, neck = c.neck, rootJ = c.rootJ }) do
if m and c.o[_gXD] then pcall(function() m.C0 = c.o[_gXD] end) end
end
for _gEl, L in pairs(c.legs or {}) do
if L.ik then pcall(function() L.ik.Weight = 0 end); L.w = 0 end
end
if c.hum and c.camBase then pcall(function() c.hum.CameraOffset = c.camBase + _gVc.off + _gki.off end) end
_gSh.bob = Vector3.zero
if c.dust then pcall(function() c.dust.Enabled = false end) end
end
function _gSh.reset()
local c = _gSh.c
if c then
_gSh.restore(c)
if c.conn then pcall(function() c.conn:Disconnect() end) end
for _gEl, L in pairs(c.legs or {}) do
if L.ik then pcall(function() L.ik:Destroy() end) end
end
if c.targets then pcall(function() c.targets:Destroy() end) end
if c.dustAtt then pcall(function() c.dustAtt:Destroy() end) end
end
_gSh.c = nil
_gSh.fall, _gSh.landPos, _gSh.landVel, _gSh.clean = 0, 0, 0, true
_gSh.pf, _gSh.acc, _gSh.bob, _gSh.bobPh = 0, 0, Vector3.zero, 0
_gSh.gl = { t = 1.5, yaw = 0, pit = 0, hold = false }
_gSh.pdist = 0
if _gSh.splash then pcall(function() _gSh.splash.part:Destroy() end); _gSh.splash = nil end
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gSh.prints) do pcall(function() p:Destroy() end) end
_gSh.prints = {}
for _gXD in pairs(_gSh.sm) do _gSh.sm[_gXD] = 0 end
end

local function _gUD(part, name)
local p = char:FindFirstChild(part); return p and p:FindFirstChild(name)
end

neck = r6 and _gUD(_h5("zu2Vk8I"), _h5("1OeEiw")) or _gUD(_h5("0ueGhA"), _h5("1OeEiw")),

o = {}, legs = {},
}
for _gXD, m in pairs({ waist = c.waist, neck = c.neck, rootJ = c.rootJ }) do if m then c.o[_gXD] = m.C0 end end
local _gmI = char:FindFirstChild(_h5("1u2Qhd+5FEPJLg"))
for _gEl, side in ipairs({ _h5("1ueBlA"), _h5("yOuAiNk") }) do
local up, lo, ft = char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("z/KXhd+hHlY")), char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("1u2Qhd+hHlY")), char:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("3O2IlA"))
local _gqA = _gmI and _gmI:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("0uuX"))
local _gQF = up and up:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("0eyChQ"))
local _gHm = lo and lo:FindFirstChild(side .. _h5("2+yMjMg"))

len = (_gqA.C1.Position - _gQF.C0.Position).Magnitude + (_gQF.C1.Position - _gHm.C0.Position).Magnitude,

end
end

_gSh.fall = 0
end
end)

_gSh.clean = false
end

function _gSh.stamp(c, _guA)

local _gVQ = c.root.CFrame.RightVector
_gVQ = _gVQ - n * _gVQ:Dot(n)
if _gVQ.Magnitude < 0.05 then return end
_gVQ = _gVQ.Unit
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not _gJp then return end
local _gmP = Instance.new(_h5("yuOVlA"))
_gmP.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
_gmP.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.55, 0.95) 
_gmP.Anchored, _gmP.CanCollide, _gmP.CanQuery, _gmP.CanTouch, _gmP.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
_gmP.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
_gmP.Color = _gih[_guA.Material]
_gmP.Transparency = 0.3
_gmP.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(_guA.Position + n * 0.03 + _gVQ * (_gSh.side * 0.55), n, _gVQ)
_gmP.Parent = _gJp
local list = _gSh.prints
list[#list + 1] = _gmP
if #list > 40 then local _gXK = table.remove(list, 1); pcall(function() _gXK:Destroy() end) end
TweenService:Create(_gmP, TweenInfo.new(7, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
Debris:AddItem(_gmP, 7.3)
end

local function _gwA(inst)
local m = inst and inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(_h5("1+2DhcE"))

end
function _gSh.update(_gSt)
local c = _gSh.c
if not c or not c.char.Parent or c.hum.Health <= 0 then return end
local R = E.perf and _gSh.perfR or S.real
local _gKm = R.footIK or R.lean or R.head or R.breathe or R.land or R.brake or R.dust or R.camBob
or R.headLead or R.glance or R.prints or R.splash or R.shake
if _gKm then _gSh.clean = false elseif _gSh.clean then return end
_gSt = math.min(_gSt, 0.05); _gSh.t += _gSt
local hum, root, sm = c.hum, c.root, _gSh.sm
local state = hum:GetState()
local _gc4 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local _gnI = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gc4)
local speed = Vector3.new(_gc4.X, 0, _gc4.Z).Magnitude
local _gAz = hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
local _gcU = hum.Sit or hum.PlatformStand or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
local _gJK = (not _gcU) and (E.track == nil) 
local _gHl = 1 - math.exp(-_gSt * 10)
if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then _gSh.fall = math.max(_gSh.fall, -_gc4.Y) end

do
local _guy = -_gnI.Z
local _gPP = math.clamp((_guy - _gSh.pf) / math.max(_gSt, 0.001), -300, 300)
_gSh.pf = _guy
_gSh.acc += (_gPP - _gSh.acc) * (1 - math.exp(-_gSt * 12))
end


local _gFU = speed < 3 and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude < 0.1
and (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
local _gD4 = R.footIK and _gJK and _gAz and _gFU and not c.r6
if _gD4 and c.ik == nil then _gSh.ensureIK(c) end
local _gbO
if c.ik then
local r = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 3), 0), c.params)
_gbO = r and r.Position.Y
end

local _ggK, _gvA, _gbK, _gBI, _gU0 = 0, {}, 0, 0, true
for _gEl in pairs(c.legs) do _ggK += 1 end
if _gD4 and c.ik and _gbO and _ggK > 0 then
for side, L in pairs(c.legs) do
local fp = L.ft.Position
local _guR = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(fp.X, _gbO + R.reach + 0.5, fp.Z), Vector3.new(0, -(R.reach * 2 + 1), 0), c.params)
if _guR and _guR.Normal.Y >= 0.7 and not _gwA(_guR.Instance) then
local d = _guR.Position.Y - _gbO
if math.abs(d) <= R.reach then
_gvA[side] = { pos = _guR.Position, n = _guR.Normal, d = d }; _gbK += 1; _gBI = math.max(_gBI, math.abs(d))
else _gU0 = false end
else _gU0 = false end
end
end

if not _gU0 or _gbK < _ggK or _gBI < 0.05 then _gvA = {}; _gbK = 0 end

local _gMs = 0
for _gEl, _gLz in pairs(_gvA) do if _gLz.d < _gMs then _gMs = _gLz.d end end
local _gEN = (R.pelvis and _gJK) and _gMs * 0.5 or 0
local _gsA = _gEN - sm.p 

local _gZN, _gxK = {}, 0
for side, _gLz in pairs(_gvA) do
local L = c.legs[side]
local n = _gLz.n
local _gVQ = root.CFrame.RightVector
_gVQ = _gVQ - n * _gVQ:Dot(n)
if _gVQ.Magnitude > 0.01 then
_gVQ = _gVQ.Unit
local _glR = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, _gVQ, n)
local center = _gLz.pos + n * (L.ft.Size.Y / 2)
local _gIm = center + _glR:VectorToWorldSpace(L.ank)
local _grA = (L.hip.Part0.CFrame * L.hip.C0).Position + Vector3.new(0, _gsA, 0)
if (_gIm - _grA).Magnitude <= L.len * 0.96 then 
_gZN[side] = CFrame.new(center) * _glR; _gxK += 1
end
end
end
local _gom = (_ggK > 0 and _gxK == _ggK)  
if not _gom then _gZN = {}; _gEN = 0 end
for side, L in pairs(c.legs) do
if L.ik then
local _glq = _gZN[side]
if _glq then L.tp.CFrame = _glq end
L.w += ((_glq and 1 or 0) - L.w) * _gHl
L.ik.Weight = L.w
L.ik.Enabled = L.w > 0.01
end
end
sm.p += (_gEN - sm.p) * _gHl

if R.land then
_gSh.landVel += (-120 * _gSh.landPos - 14 * _gSh.landVel) * _gSt
_gSh.landPos += _gSh.landVel * _gSt
else
_gSh.landPos, _gSh.landVel = 0, 0
end

local _gON, _ghR = 0, 0
if R.lean and _gJK then
_gON = -math.clamp(-_gnI.Z * 0.011, -0.15, 0.22) * R.leanAmt 
_ghR = math.clamp(root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y * 0.05 - _gnI.X * 0.012, -0.3, 0.3) * R.leanAmt
end

if R.brake and _gJK and _gAz then
_gON += math.clamp(-_gSh.acc * 0.0045, 0, 0.3) * R.leanAmt
end
sm.pitch += (_gON - sm.pitch) * _gHl; sm.roll += (_ghR - sm.roll) * _gHl



local _gTB, _gTA = 0, 0
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
local _giC = _gVc.first
local _gGI = hum.MoveDirection
local _gkJ = _gGI.Magnitude > 0.1
if (R.head or R.headLead or R.glance) and _gJK then

if R.head and _gJp and not _giC then
local _gXF = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gJp.CFrame.LookVector)
_gTB = math.clamp(math.atan2(-_gXF.X, -_gXF.Z), -1.2, 1.2) * 0.85
_gTA = math.clamp(math.asin(math.clamp(_gXF.Y, -1, 1)), -0.6, 0.6) * 0.8
end
if R.headLead and _gkJ and not _giC and hum.AutoRotate and UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
local _gXF = root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(_gGI)
local _gBm = math.atan2(-_gXF.X, -_gXF.Z) 
if math.abs(_gBm) < 2.3 then _gTB = math.clamp(_gBm, -1.2, 1.2) * 0.9 end 
end
local gl = _gSh.gl
if R.glance and not _gkJ and speed < 0.5 and _gAz then
gl.t -= _gSt
if gl.t <= 0 then
if gl.hold then
gl.yaw, gl.pit, gl.hold = 0, 0, false
gl.t = 2.5 + math.random() * 4.5
else
gl.yaw = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.75
gl.pit = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 0.25
gl.hold = true
gl.t = 0.8 + math.random() * 1.4
end
end
local _gXD = _giC and 0.35 or 1 
local _goy = 1 - math.clamp(math.abs(_gTB) / 0.4, 0, 1) 
_gTB += gl.yaw * _gXD * _goy; _gTA += gl.pit * _gXD * _goy
else
gl.yaw, gl.pit, gl.hold, gl.t = 0, 0, false, 1.5
end
end
local _ggm = 1 - math.exp(-_gSt * 8)
sm.hy += (_gTB - sm.hy) * _ggm; sm.hp += (_gTA - sm.hp) * _ggm

local _gfp = (R.breathe and _gJK and _gAz and speed < 0.5) and math.sin(_gSh.t * 1.8) * 0.012 or 0
sm.br += (_gfp - sm.br) * _gHl

if R.dust and _gJK and _gAz and speed > 9 then
local d = _gSh.ensureDust(c)
if d then
d.Rate = math.clamp((speed - 9) * 3, 0, 26)
local _gAI = hum.FloorMaterial
if c.dustMat ~= _gAI then c.dustMat = _gAI; d.Color = ColorSequence.new(_gvc[_gAI] or _gwc) end
d.Enabled = true
end
elseif c.dust then
c.dust.Enabled = false
end

local _gJo = Vector3.zero
if R.camBob and _gJK and _gAz and speed > 2 then
_gSh.bobPh += _gSt * speed * 0.6
local _gXD = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.3, 1.6) * R.camAmt
_gJo = Vector3.new(math.cos(_gSh.bobPh) * 0.05 * _gXD, (math.abs(math.sin(_gSh.bobPh)) - 0.5) * 0.12 * _gXD, 0)
end
_gSh.bob = _gSh.bob:Lerp(_gJo, _gHl)
if _gSh.bob.Magnitude > 0.0005 or _gSh.bobOn then
_gSh.bobOn = _gSh.bob.Magnitude > 0.0005
pcall(function() hum.CameraOffset = c.camBase + _gVc.off + _gki.off + _gSh.bob end)
end

local _gVw
if (R.prints or R.splash) and not _gcU and speed > 2.5 then _gVw = _gSh.floorRay(c) end
if R.splash and _gVw and _gVw.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
local _gQT = _gSh.ensureSplash()
if _gQT then
_gQT.part.CFrame = CFrame.new(_gVw.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0))
_gQT.pe.Rate = math.clamp(speed * 2.2, 6, 34)
_gQT.pe.Enabled = true
end
elseif _gSh.splash and _gSh.splash.pe.Enabled then
_gSh.splash.pe.Enabled = false
end
if R.prints and _gJK and _gAz and _gVw and _gih[_gVw.Material] then
_gSh.pdist += speed * _gSt
if _gSh.pdist >= 2.2 then _gSh.pdist = 0; _gSh.side = -_gSh.side; _gSh.stamp(c, _gVw) end
end

local o = c.o
if c.rootJ and o.rootJ then c.rootJ.C0 = o.rootJ * CFrame.new(0, sm.p + _gSh.landPos, 0) end
if c.waist and o.waist then c.waist.C0 = o.waist * CFrame.Angles(sm.pitch + sm.br + _gSh.landPos * 0.5, 0, sm.roll) end

if c.neck and o.neck then

c.neck.C0 = CFrame.new(o.neck.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, sm.hy, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(sm.hp - sm.pitch * 0.5, 0, -sm.roll * 0.5) * o.neck.Rotation
end

if not _gKm then
local m = math.abs(sm.p) + math.abs(sm.pitch) + math.abs(sm.roll) + math.abs(sm.hy) + math.abs(sm.hp) + math.abs(sm.br) + math.abs(_gSh.landPos)
for _gEl, L in pairs(c.legs) do m += L.w end
m += _gSh.bob.Magnitude
if m < 0.002 then _gSh.restore(c); _gSh.clean = true end
end
end
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(_gSt)
local _gJK, err = pcall(_gSh.update, _gSt)
if not _gJK and not _gSh.warned then _gSh.warned = true; warn(_h5("wcWzoY2oFl7OJCvA+N/HksiMF1jJLAyPug") .. tostring(err)) end
end)






local _gWc = { Hat = true, Hair = true, Face = true, Neck = true, Eyebrow = true, Eyelash = true }
local _gXc = 9 
function _gVc.setZoom(lo, hi)
pcall(function() _gwf.CameraMinZoomDistance = lo; _gwf.CameraMaxZoomDistance = hi end)
end

function _gVc.applyOffset()
local _gEl, hum = E.parts()
if not hum then return end
local base = (_gSh.c and _gSh.c.camBase) or _gVc.base0 or Vector3.zero
pcall(function() hum.CameraOffset = base + _gVc.off + _gki.off + _gSh.bob end)
end
function _gVc.rebuild()
_gVc.body, _gVc.hide = {}, {}
local c = _gwf.Character
if not c then _gVc.head, _gVc.neck = nil, nil; return end
_gVc.head = c:FindFirstChild(_h5("0ueGhA"))
local _geK = _gVc.head and _gVc.head:FindFirstChild(_h5("1OeEiw")) 
if not _geK then local _gSW = c:FindFirstChild(_h5("zu2Vk8I")); _geK = _gSW and _gSW:FindFirstChild(_h5("1OeEiw")) end 
_gVc.neck = (_geK and _geK:IsA(_h5("1+2Tj9/bPw"))) and _geK or nil
for _gEl, d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA(_h5("2OOUhf2MCUU")) and d.Name ~= _h5("0veKgcOCElXoLgzByuOVlA") then
local acc = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass(_h5("2+GEhd6eFEPD"))
local hide = false
if acc then
local _gJK, tp = pcall(function() return acc.AccessoryType.Name end)
hide = _gJK and _gWc[tp] == true
else
hide = (d.Name == _h5("0ueGhA") and d.Parent == c)
end
local list = hide and _gVc.hide or _gVc.body
list[#list + 1] = d
end
end
end
function _gVc.hook(char)
if _gVc.dconn then pcall(function() _gVc.dconn:Disconnect() end); _gVc.dconn = nil end
_gVc.dirty = true
if char then _gVc.dconn = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function() _gVc.dirty = true end) end
end

local function _gky()
for _gEl, list in ipairs({ _gVc.body, _gVc.hide }) do
for _gEl, p in ipairs(list) do if p.Parent then pcall(function() p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0 end) end end
end
end

function _gVc.dropNative()
if _gVc.nativeCF then
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if _gJp then pcall(function() _gJp.CFrame = _gVc.nativeCF end) end
end
_gVc.nativeCF = nil
_gVc.bob, _gVc.roll, _gVc.ph = Vector3.zero, 0, 0
end
function _gVc.restoreZoom()
if _gVc.zmin then _gVc.setZoom(_gVc.zmin, _gVc.zmax) end
end

function _gVc.pullOut(_gVE)
_gVc.tok += 1
local _guJ = _gVc.tok
local lo, hi = _gVc.zmin or 0.5, _gVc.zmax or 128
local d = math.clamp(_gXc, lo, hi)
_gVc.setZoom(d, d)
task.delay(0.3, function()
if _gVc.tok ~= _guJ then return end 
_gVc.setZoom(lo, hi)
if not _gVE then _gVc.zmin, _gVc.zmax = nil, nil end
end)
end
function _gVc.goFirst()
_gVc.tok += 1
_gVc.first = true
_gVc.rebuild(); _gVc.dirty = false
_gVc.setZoom(0.5, 0.5)
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if _gJp and not _gVc.fov0 then _gVc.fov0 = _gki.fov0 or _gJp.FieldOfView end
_gVc.off = Vector3.new(0, 0, -S.fp.depth)
_gVc.applyOffset()
end
function _gVc.goOut(_gVE)
_gVc.first = false
_gVc.dropNative()
_gky()
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if _gJp and _gVc.fov0 then _gJp.FieldOfView = _gVc.fov0 end
_gVc.fov0 = nil
_gVc.off = Vector3.zero
_gVc.applyOffset()
_gVc.pullOut(_gVE)
end
function _gVc.sync()
local F = S.fp
if F.on and not _gVc.begun then
_gVc.begun = true
if not _gVc.zmin then _gVc.zmin, _gVc.zmax = _gwf.CameraMinZoomDistance, _gwf.CameraMaxZoomDistance end
_gVc.hook(_gwf.Character)
local _gEl, hum = E.parts()
_gVc.base0 = hum and hum.CameraOffset or Vector3.zero
elseif not F.on and _gVc.begun then
_gVc.begun = false
if _gVc.first then _gVc.goOut(false) else _gVc.restoreZoom(); _gVc.zmin, _gVc.zmax = nil, nil end
_gVc.hook(nil)
return
end
if not _gVc.begun then return end
local _gC4 = not (F.emoteOut and E.track ~= nil)
if _gC4 and not _gVc.first then _gVc.goFirst()
elseif (not _gC4) and _gVc.first then _gVc.goOut(true) end
if _gVc.first and (_gwf.CameraMinZoomDistance ~= 0.5 or _gwf.CameraMaxZoomDistance ~= 0.5) then _gVc.setZoom(0.5, 0.5) end
end
function _gVc.toggle()
S.fp.on = not S.fp.on; _gOR(); _gVc.sync()
for _gEl, p in ipairs(UI.paints) do pcall(p) end 
notify(_h5("yvCOjciECVCaMQbG6e2G"), S.fp.on and _h5("9uuAgcmM") or _h5("/ueUjMSKGlXb"))
end

function _gki.zoom(d)
if _gVc.first then return end
_gki.tok = (_gki.tok or 0) + 1
local _guJ = _gki.tok
local lo = _gki.lo or _gVc.zmin or _gwf.CameraMinZoomDistance
local hi = _gki.hi or _gVc.zmax or _gwf.CameraMaxZoomDistance
_gki.lo, _gki.hi = lo, hi
d = math.clamp(d, lo, hi)
_gVc.setZoom(d, d)
task.delay(0.3, function()
if _gki.tok ~= _guJ then return end
if not _gVc.first then _gVc.setZoom(lo, hi) end
_gki.lo, _gki.hi = nil, nil
end)
end
function _gki.sync()
local F = S.sh
local _gC4 = F.on and not _gVc.first
local target = _gC4 and Vector3.new(F.side * F.x, F.y, 0) or Vector3.zero
if target ~= _gki.off then _gki.off = target; _gVc.applyOffset() end
if _gC4 and not _gki.active then _gki.active = true; _gki.zoom(F.dist)
elseif not _gC4 and _gki.active then _gki.active = false end
end
function _gVc.charAdded(char, hum)
if _gVc.first then _gVc.dropNative(); _gVc.first = false; _gVc.off = Vector3.zero end 
_gVc.body, _gVc.hide = {}, {}
_gVc.base0 = hum and hum.CameraOffset or Vector3.zero
if _gVc.begun then _gVc.hook(char) end
end



local function _gLp()
if not _gVc.nativeCF then return end
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if _gJp then _gJp.CFrame = _gVc.nativeCF end
end
local function _gNp(_gSt)
local _gJp = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not _gJp then return end
local R = E.perf and _gSh.perfR or S.real
local F = S.fp

if S.sh.on and S.sh.fovOn and not _gVc.first then
if not _gki.fov0 then _gki.fov0 = _gJp.FieldOfView end
if _gJp.FieldOfView ~= S.sh.fov then _gJp.FieldOfView = S.sh.fov end
elseif _gki.fov0 then
_gJp.FieldOfView = _gki.fov0; _gki.fov0 = nil
end
_gnb.t += _gSt
_gnb.amp *= math.exp(-_gSt * 5)
if _gnb.amp < 0.003 then _gnb.amp = 0 end
local c = _gwf.Character
local root = c and c:FindFirstChild(_h5("0veKgcOCElXoLgzByuOVlA"))
local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass(_h5("0veKgcOCElU"))
local _gE4 = (root ~= nil) and R.camLean
if not (_gVc.first or _gE4 or _gnb.amp > 0 or math.abs(_gnb.roll) > 1e-3) then
_gVc.dropNative()
return
end
if _gVc.first then
if _gVc.dirty then _gVc.dirty = false; _gVc.rebuild() end

local _gRB, _gwp = F.hideHead and 1 or 0, F.body and 0 or 1
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gVc.hide) do if p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = _gRB end end
for _gEl, p in ipairs(_gVc.body) do if p.Parent then p.LocalTransparencyModifier = _gwp end end
if _gJp.FieldOfView ~= F.fov then _gJp.FieldOfView = F.fov end
end
if not (root and hum) then _gVc.nativeCF = nil; return end
_gVc.nativeCF = _gJp.CFrame
local _glR, pos = _gVc.nativeCF.Rotation, _gVc.nativeCF.Position
local _gHl = 1 - math.exp(-_gSt * 10)
local _gc4 = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local _gaO = Vector3.new(_gc4.X, 0, _gc4.Z)
local speed = _gaO.Magnitude
if _gVc.first then
local head = _gVc.head
if F.follow and head and head.Parent then

pos = head.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, 0.1, -F.depth))

local _geK = _gVc.neck
if _geK and _geK.Part0 and F.followAmt > 0 then
local base = (_geK.Part0.CFrame * _geK.C0).Rotation
local d = base * _geK.Transform.Rotation * base:Inverse()
_glR = CFrame.new():Lerp(d, F.followAmt) * _glR
end

local sm = _gSh.sm
_glR = CFrame.Angles(0, sm.hy * F.followAmt, 0) * _glR * CFrame.Angles(sm.hp * F.followAmt, 0, 0)
end

local _gXD = F.motion
local _gJo, _ghR = Vector3.zero, 0
if _gXD > 0 and (F.follow or not R.camBob) then
if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and speed > 2 then
_gVc.ph += _gSt * speed * 0.6
local _gPF = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0.3, 1.6) * _gXD
_gJo = Vector3.new(math.cos(_gVc.ph) * 0.04 * _gPF, (math.abs(math.sin(_gVc.ph)) - 0.5) * 0.1 * _gPF, 0)
end
_ghR = -math.clamp(root.CFrame.RightVector:Dot(_gaO) / 16, -1.5, 1.5) * 0.04 * _gXD
end
_gVc.bob = _gVc.bob:Lerp(_gJo, _gHl)
_gVc.roll += (_ghR - _gVc.roll) * _gHl
else
_gVc.bob, _gVc.roll = Vector3.zero, 0
end

local _ggR = 0
if _gE4 then
_ggR = math.clamp(root.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Y * 0.04, -0.14, 0.14) * math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1.2) * R.leanAmt
end
_gnb.roll += (_ggR - _gnb.roll) * (1 - math.exp(-_gSt * 6))

local sp, _gdV, _glU, _gND = 0, 0, 0, 0
if _gnb.amp > 0 then
local t, _gXD = _gnb.t, _gnb.amp
sp = math.sin(t * 52) * _gXD * 0.03
_gdV = math.sin(t * 43 + 1.3) * _gXD * 0.02
_glU = math.sin(t * 37 + 2.1) * _gXD * 0.025
_gND = (math.sin(t * 58) * 0.04 - 0.22) * _gXD
end
local _gMp = _glR * CFrame.Angles(sp, _gdV, (_gVc.first and _gVc.roll or 0) + _gnb.roll + _glU)
_gJp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, _gND, 0) + _gMp:VectorToWorldSpace(_gVc.bob)) * _gMp
end
pcall(function() RunService:BindToRenderStep(_h5("38q4pv2yK2P/"), Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, _gLp) end)
pcall(function() RunService:BindToRenderStep(_h5("38q4pv0"), Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, _gNp) end)
function _gVc.shutdown() 
if _gVc.begun then
_gVc.begun = false
if _gVc.first then _gVc.goOut(false) else _gVc.restoreZoom() end
end
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(_h5("38q4pv0")) end)
pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(_h5("38q4pv2yK2P/")) end)
if _gVc.dconn then pcall(function() _gVc.dconn:Disconnect() end) end
end
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() _gVc.sync() end)
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(_gVB, _gUO)
if _gUO or _gVB.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or _gVB.KeyCode ~= _grb.FpKey then return end
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or UI.capturing then return end
_gVc.toggle()
end)
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function() _gki.sync() end)
UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(_gVB, _gUO)
if _gUO or _gVB.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or _gVB.KeyCode ~= _grb.ShoulderKey then return end
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or UI.capturing then return end
S.sh.on = not S.sh.on; _gOR()
if S.sh.on then _gki.zoom(S.sh.dist) end
for _gEl, p in ipairs(UI.paints) do pcall(p) end
notify(_h5("2UFFjcifGhHeJEPa9+CVjw"), S.sh.on and _h5("9uuAgcmM") or _h5("/ueUjMSKGlXb"))
end)



local _gIc = { last = {}, any = 0, fall = 0, runT = 0, conns = {}, hp = 100, lowHp = false }
function _gIc.unhook()
for _gEl, _glr in ipairs(_gIc.conns) do pcall(function() _glr:Disconnect() end) end
_gIc.conns = {}
end
local function _gVu(key)
local cfg = S.ev[key]
if not cfg or not cfg.on then return end
local _guK = os.clock()
if _guK - (_gIc.last[key] or 0) < S.evCd or _guK - _gIc.any < 0.8 then return end
local _gEl, hum = E.parts()
if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or E.track ~= nil then return end 
local id = cfg.emote
if id == 0 then
local pool = E.pool()
id = pool[math.random(math.max(#pool, 1))]
end
if not id then return end
_gIc.last[key], _gIc.any = _guK, _guK
task.spawn(E.play, id, true)
end
function _gIc.hook(char, hum)
_gIc.unhook()
_gIc.fall, _gIc.runT, _gIc.lowHp, _gIc.hp = 0, 0, false, hum.Health
local function add(_glr) _gIc.conns[#_gIc.conns + 1] = _glr end
add(hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_gXK, new)
local _gLj = Enum.HumanoidStateType
if new == _gLj.Jumping then _gVu(_h5("8PeKkA"))
elseif new == _gLj.Landed then
local _ghv = _gIc.fall; _gIc.fall = 0
if _ghv >= S.evLandMin then _gVu(_h5("9uOJhA")) end
elseif new == _gLj.Swimming then _gVu(_h5("6fWOjQ"))
elseif _gXK == _gLj.Swimming then _gVu(_h5("6fWOjeiDHw")) end
end))
add(hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal(_h5("yeuT")):Connect(function() _gVu(hum.Sit and _h5("6euT") or _h5("6faGjsk")) end))
add(char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(_gxq) if _gxq:IsA(_h5("zu2IjA")) then _gVu(_h5("//OSid0")) end end))
add(char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(_gxq) if _gxq:IsA(_h5("zu2IjA")) then _gVu(_h5("7+yCkdiECw")) end end))
add(hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(_gLz)
if _gLz < _gIc.hp - 0.5 and _gLz > 0 then _gVu(_h5("8veVlA")) end
local _gmy = _gLz / math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
if _gmy < 0.3 and _gLz > 0 and not _gIc.lowHp then _gIc.lowHp = true; _gVu(_h5("9u2Q"))
elseif _gmy > 0.5 then _gIc.lowHp = false end
_gIc.hp = _gLz
end))
end

UI.conns[#UI.conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(_gSt)
local _gEl, hum = E.parts()
local root = hum and hum.RootPart
if not root then return end
local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local sp = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then _gIc.fall = math.max(_gIc.fall, -v.Y) end
if sp >= S.evRunMin then _gIc.runT += _gSt
elseif sp < 1.5 then
if _gIc.runT >= 0.5 then _gVu(_h5("6faIkP+YFQ")) end
_gIc.runT = 0
end
end)

local function update(_gSt)
if not active then return end
_gJp = _gvl.CurrentCamera
local _grJ = Vector3.zero
if not _gRk:GetFocusedTextBox() then
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
if _gRk:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
end
if _gTM.F then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
if _gTM.B then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
if _gTM.L then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
if _gTM.R then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
if _gTM.U then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
if _gTM.D then _grJ = _grJ + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
local _glR = CFrame.fromOrientation(pitch, yaw, 0)
local dir = _glR:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(_grJ.X, 0, _grJ.Z)) + Vector3.new(0, _grJ.Y, 0)
if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
local _ghz = dir * speed
if _gFT then _gc4 = _gc4:Lerp(_ghz, 1 - math.exp(-8 * _gSt)) else _gc4 = _ghz end
_gKp = CFrame.new(_gKp.Position + _gc4 * _gSt) * _glR
_gJp.CFrame = _gKp
_gJp.FieldOfView = fov
end
local function stop()
if not active then return end
active = false
pcall(function() _gfi:UnbindFromRenderStep(_gui) end)
pcall(function() _gob:UnbindAction(_gb) end)
_gWr(true)
if saved then
_gJp.CameraType = saved.ct
_gJp.CameraSubject = saved.subj
_gJp.FieldOfView = saved.fov
saved = nil
end
_gc4, _gmR, _gbR = Vector3.zero, nil, false
for _gXD in pairs(_gTM) do _gTM[_gXD] = false end
_gVM.Visible = false
_gTn.Text = _h5("2e2KhW5KGkM")
end

end

if _gVB.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and _gbR then
yaw = yaw - math.rad(_gVB.Delta.X * 0.3)
pitch = math.clamp(pitch - math.rad(_gVB.Delta.Y * 0.3), -1.5, 1.5)
elseif _gVB == _gmR then
yaw = yaw - math.rad(_gVB.Delta.X * 0.4)
pitch = math.clamp(pitch - math.rad(_gVB.Delta.Y * 0.4), -1.5, 1.5)
end
end)

end
